test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

Megan, my __precious __darling, where is the kettle?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Detested**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Precious **means valuable or cherished. (मूल्यवान या पोषित)

 
 
• **For example- ***She gave me the precious gift of friendship.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Detested **means hated or despised. (घृणा या तिरस्कार किया हुआ)
